> PANDUCK is a personalized training wearable designed to turn real-time body and movement data into actionable training insights. Unlike a basic fitness tracker that mainly displays sensor readings, PANDUCK combines physiological data, activity data, and training history to help users understand fatigue and make better training decisions.
